room_rent.note: Room category specified in the Schedule; exact cap/category not stated in wording

icu.note: ICU/CCU/HDU charges covered; specific cap not stated in wording

copayment.note: Base plan has no mandatory co-pay. Optional co-pay add-on (2.12.14) gives premium discount. Co-pay also triggered if First Notification (2.12.12) or Preferred Provider (2.12.13) conditions are breached.

sub_limits.display: No standard sub-limits; Schedule may specify
sub_limits.note: Wording does not list disease-wise sub-limits in base cover; underwriting may impose specific sub-limits via Schedule (4.12)

deductible.note: Floater Deductible (2.12.15) and Individual Deductible (2.12.16) are optional add-ons; base plan has no deductible

initial_waiting.note: Waivable via optional add-on 2.12.6 (Initial 30 Days Waiting Period Waiver)

ped_waiting.note: PED defined as conditions diagnosed/treated within 36 months prior to policy start; waiting period in months as per Schedule; reducible via portability

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list of specified diseases (cataract, hernia, arthritis, kidney, etc.); waiting period in months per Schedule; removable via optional add-ons 2.12.2 or 2.12.3

maternity.note: Maternity (childbirth, C-section, miscarriage, MTP) explicitly excluded under 3.1.16; ectopic pregnancy is an exception and is covered

cumulative_bonus.display: Optional; rate & cap as per Schedule
cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus (2.12.8) and No Claim Bonus SI (2.12.9) are optional add-ons; Inflation Protect SI (2.12.5) also optional; no inbuilt bonus in base plan

restoration.display: Optional; unlimited if specified in Schedule
restoration.note: Restore Sum Insured (2.12.11) is an optional add-on; can restore multiple times if Schedule specifies unlimited; not available for first claim in policy year; covers related and unrelated illnesses as per Schedule

pre_hosp.note: Number of days specified in the Schedule; exact number not stated in wording

post_hosp.note: Number of days specified in the Schedule; exact number not stated in wording

day_care.note: List hosted on Acko website; AYUSH day care also covered

domiciliary.note: Covered if treatment at home due to inability to move or non-availability of beds; must continue ≥3 consecutive days; reimbursement basis only

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient treatment covered under 2.10; AYUSH day care also covered under 2.3

organ_donor.note: Donor's in-patient hospitalization for organ harvesting covered within insured's base SI; donor pre/post-hosp, screening, transport costs excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance and emergency evacuation (domestic) covered; exact ₹ limit per Schedule

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc.; covered under base SI

consumables.note: Waiver of Non-payable Medical Expenses (2.12.1) is an optional benefit covering consumables/non-payables; not inbuilt in base plan

global_cover.note: Worldwide In-Patient Hospitalization (2.12.7) is an optional benefit; base plan excludes treatment outside India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies from enhancement date for enhanced SI portion

grace_period.note: 30 days for renewal and quarterly/half-yearly/annual instalments; 15 days for monthly instalments; no coverage for claims during renewal grace period

free_look.note: Only at inception; not applicable at renewals or porting

portability.note: As per IRDAI guidelines; waiting periods reduced by prior continuous coverage; apply 30–60 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, STDs (except HIV), sleep disorders, hormonal therapy, substance abuse, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, OPD, self-harm

optional_riders.display: Consumables waiver, Worldwide cover, Restore SI, Cumulative Bonus, No Claim Bonus SI, Inflation Protect SI, Co-pay, Deductible, Specific illness WP waiver, Doctor-on-call
